fields.en: Two people who have both spent their lives looking at plants
fields.hr: Dvoje ljudi koji su život proveli gledajući biljke

fields.en: Marko Boško has twenty seven years in media production, currently as a video editor at Nova TV in Zagreb, and works as a filmmaker, sound designer and composer under Mantra Productions. He spent seven years in Auroville, the township in South India founded on the Integral Yoga of Sri Aurobindo and the Mother, living alongside Sadhana Forest as it turned eroded ground into forest.
fields.hr: Marko Boško ima dvadeset sedam godina u medijskoj produkciji, trenutno kao montažer na Novoj TV u Zagrebu, i radi kao filmaš, sound dizajner i skladatelj pod imenom Mantra Productions. Sedam godina proveo je u Auroville, gradu u južnoj Indiji utemeljenom na Integralnoj yogi Sri Aurobinda i Majke, živeći uz Sadhana Forest dok je erodirano tlo pretvarao u šumu.

fields.en: He is a percussionist and founder of the Tribal Jam Orchestra, a yoga teacher and author of the Sun Moon Yoga method, and performs as DJ Mantra. He is based between Zagreb and Rijeka, with family roots in Zadar, twenty minutes by ferry from the land.
fields.hr: Perkusionist je i osnivač Tribal Jam Orchestra, učitelj yoge i autor metode Sun Moon Yoga, a nastupa kao DJ Mantra. Živi između Zagreba i Rijeke, s obiteljskim korijenima u Zadru, dvadeset minuta trajektom od zemlje.

fields.en: Two things from that working life matter here more than the rest. He trained as an engineer in industrial electronics and worked as a system and network administrator before the cameras, which is the skill set the test ground needs. And he documents for a living, so the survival rates, the water readings and the failures will be recorded properly and published rather than remembered loosely.
fields.hr: Dvije stvari iz tog radnog vijeka ovdje znače više od ostalog. Školovao se za inženjera industrijske elektronike i radio kao sistem i mrežni administrator prije kamera, a upravo to traži poligon. I dokumentiranje mu je zanat, pa će stope preživljavanja, očitanja vode i neuspjesi biti uredno zabilježeni i objavljeni, a ne tek otprilike zapamćeni.

fields.en: Toni Franović in his studio in Legrad.
fields.hr: Toni Franović u svom ateljeu u Legradu.

fields.en: Painter, co-author of this project. Born in Zagreb in 1964, he graduated from the Academy of Fine Arts in Zagreb in 1990 and taught life drawing and painting in nature there from 1995 to 2004. He is a professor at Sveučilište Sjever in Koprivnica and lives on an ecological estate in Legrad. He has spent his working life studying the flora of the southern Adriatic and the Mediterranean, which is why the plant list on this site is his as much as anyone's.
fields.hr: Slikar, suautor ovog projekta. Rođen u Zagrebu 1964., diplomirao na Akademiji likovnih umjetnosti u Zagrebu 1990., gdje je od 1995. do 2004. predavao crtanje akta i slikanje u prirodi. Profesor je na Sveučilištu Sjever u Koprivnici i živi na ekološkom imanju u Legradu. Radni vijek proveo je proučavajući floru južnog Jadrana i Mediterana, zbog čega je popis biljaka na ovoj stranici jednako njegov koliko i bilo čiji.

fields.en: He writes about painting as a natural cycle, taking decay and growth as equal parts of the same process. That is also the argument of this project. A landscape is not restored by being tidied, it is restored by letting the slow part of the cycle run its course again.
fields.hr: O slikarstvu piše kao o prirodnom ciklusu, uzimajući raspadanje i rast kao jednako vrijedne dijelove istog procesa. To je ujedno i teza ovog projekta. Krajolik se ne obnavlja tako da ga se uredi, nego tako da se sporom dijelu ciklusa opet dopusti da odradi svoje.
